correctness.rationale: All configurations are exhaustively classified by hub occupancy and 0/1/2 leaders in each peripheral pair. A positive-definite block Schur complement derives an explicit rational inverse trace. Seven critical identities were checked symbolically from the block formula; every relevant polynomial denominator is positive. Positive-coefficient differences rule out clustered alternatives, and discriminant/Descartes calculations settle the all-integer, all-positive-gain classification. Direct exact inverses independently verified every four-leader subset for two through five triangles at four gains (1,984 comparisons); these are corroboration and are not used to extrapolate an infinite claim.

value.rationale: The canonical clustered star/friendship family sharply distinguishes a universal hub from local triangle sensors. A complete all-m, all-gain four-leader design classification is obtained, including a strict hub→distributed→hub reversal exactly for six and seven triangles, explicit algebraic thresholds, and a common transition root product \(9/4\). The result is a natural exact design guide and structural boundary rather than a small-grid computation or an automatic generic formula.
